description: Turn goals, projects, and events into dependency-aware calendar proposals with explicit approval gates.

defaultPrompt: We’re moving across the country next spring. Help me handle everything gradually so the last month isn’t chaos.
I’m planning a big family trip next summer. Spread out the passports, bookings, and time-off stuff for me. Hunt bargains.
I want to turn my side project into a real business this year. Keep it moving, let's launch around May.
interface.longDescription: Agent Calendars turns a goal, project, or event into a clear proposed timeline with milestones, dependencies, research rounds, uncertainty, and approval windows. Version 0.1 is planning-only: it prepares reviewable calendar proposals and never schedules, sends, purchases, or authorizes actions by itself.

name: agent-calendars
